title: Service-Fee Rates, Floors and Ceilings (Cartwise Grocery Orders)
content:
**Cartwise Grocery Orders service-fee rates.** The service fee is a percentage of the order's item subtotal, held between a floor and a ceiling. The non-member rate, the floor and the ceiling are set per service level as follows; the table also shows whether the service level returns the service fee attributable to refunded items.

| Service level | Non-member service-fee rate | Service-fee floor | Service-fee ceiling | Service fee shared back with item refunds |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Curbside Pickup | 2.5 percent | 0.99 USD | 15.00 USD | yes |
| No-Rush Delivery | 5.0 percent | 2.00 USD | 20.00 USD | yes |
| Standard Delivery | 7.5 percent | 3.00 USD | 25.00 USD | yes |
| Priority Delivery | 7.5 percent | 3.00 USD | 25.00 USD | yes |
| Express 30 Delivery | 7.5 percent | 3.00 USD | 25.00 USD | yes |
| Stock-Up Delivery | 7.5 percent | 3.00 USD | 35.00 USD | yes |

### Points of reference

- **Rate** is expressed as a percent of the item subtotal and is the rate a non-member pays at that service level.
- **Floor** is the lowest service fee billed and **ceiling** the highest, in USD.
- **Shared back with item refunds** is a yes-or-no setting of the service level; it reads yes at all six Cartwise Grocery Orders service levels.

### Hypothetical subtotals against the bounds

| Hypothetical case | Service level | Rate applied to the subtotal | Against the bounds |
|---|---|---|---|
| Item subtotal 20.00 USD | Standard Delivery | 7.5 percent of 20.00 is 1.50 | below the 3.00 floor |
| Item subtotal 100.00 USD | Standard Delivery | 7.5 percent of 100.00 is 7.50 | between floor and ceiling |
| Item subtotal 400.00 USD | Standard Delivery | 7.5 percent of 400.00 is 30.00 | above the 25.00 ceiling |
| Item subtotal 400.00 USD | Stock-Up Delivery | 7.5 percent of 400.00 is 30.00 | below the 35.00 ceiling |
